sets.relationshipLabel: a creature and a body part it simply has
sets.explanation: An octopus has arms and a crab has claws the same way any creature has its built-in parts — no ambiguity, just anatomy.

sets.relationshipLabel: a broad category of reef creature and a specific kind within it
sets.explanation: Clownfish is a kind of fish and nautilus is a kind of mollusk — each pair moves from the general class to one specific member of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: the thing that stops a predator's success
sets.explanation: Ink blocks capture and camouflage blocks detection — each is a defense whose whole purpose is denying the predator its outcome.

sets.relationshipLabel: two facing phases across one span
sets.explanation: Ebb and flood sit opposite each other in the tidal cycle just as crescent and full sit opposite each other in the lunar cycle.
